note: San Juan NF campground under ponderosa pine midway up the east shore of Vallecito Reservoir (~7,900 ft), ~14 miles north of Bayfield via County Road 501 and then Forest Road 603 (CR 501A). Views of the high peaks to the northwest. The shore at the campground is not sheltered for mooring boats; a sheltered boat area and open play area are just south. No gas on the east side of the reservoir. --Claude

Length conflict: FS 'Max RV size = 40 ft'; recreation.gov's catalog lists site 017 at 45 ft, 010/011/020 at 35, 013 at 34, 014/016 at 32, most others 30; tent-only 012 (18) and 027 (20). Recorded the FS 40. Every RV site is catalogued at 30 ft or more.

Waterfront lakefront confirmed (no change): recreation.gov's catalog tags 009, 011, 013, 015, 017, 018 and 019 'Lakefront' (all priced at the $39 lakefront rate, with 012 tent-only), and its description says 'many shaded, lakefront sites with easy access to the shore'. On Esri imagery those site points sit ~10-50 m from the shoreline under pine canopy (011 ~10 m, 013 ~25 m, 015 ~35 m, 017/018 ~45-50 m); the canopy hides the pads, so the per-site catalog is the authority. The FS adds 'Some are near the water, but the area is not well protected for mooring boats.'

Roads after the October 2026 floods: the San Juan NF Columbine road-status table (as of October 26, 2026) lists 'East Vallecito at Mile 1.5 | 603 | 5/1 | 11/30' with no special condition or flood closure; County Roads 501/501A are county roads not in that table, and no FS alert names them. The forest-wide flood alert (October 23, 2026) warns of widespread road damage and asks the public to avoid the forest for now. No campground closure; the campground is past its May-September season.
Pin 37.39917,-107.53504 is ~135 m SE of the catalog site centroid (37.40022,-107.53581), by sites 031/032 and the entrance road. OK.
